reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 CKLE distills LLM text knowledge into a multimodal EHR prediction model and reports prediction improvements on heart-failure/hypertension tasks. It is motivated partly by local deployment constraints and may reduce reliance on running an LLM at serving time, but the paper does not quantify resulting LLM inference compute, latency or memory savings; keep as borderline.
title: Distilling the knowledge from large-language model for health event prediction
